PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 

Over 8+ years of total work experience, including 4 years in non-IT roles and 4 years in IT, specializing in Software Testing

Accomplished Software Testing professional with expertise in Database and ETL testing, as well as Reports testing in Power BI

CAREER OVERVIEW  

Having experience on ETL Testing and Power BI Report Testing.

Having Good Knowledge on Data Warehousing Concepts.

Good knowledge and working exposure on Extraction Transform and Load

(ETL)Process. 

Good experience on Oracle, MS SQL Server databases, Azure Databricks.

Hands on experience on creating and executing the SQL queries as per the requirement document.

Having experience on preparing test Scenarios & Test cases as per the requirement.

Hands on experience in all stages of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).

Involved in the whole process of manual testing, database, ETL and Report testing including interaction with client.

Engaged with the Functional testing, Database Testing, Report Testing, Integration testing, System testing and Regression testing.

Excellent Analytical, problem solving, communication and interpersonal skills.

WORK SUMMARY

Currently working as Senior Test Engineer in Happiest Minds Technologies from 25-Apr-2023 to till date.

Associate-Project at Cognizant Technology Solutions from 06-Dec-2021 to 31-Jan-2023.

Data Processing officer at Andhra Pradesh Corporation for Outsourced Services from          01-Jul-2020 to 03-Dec-2021.

Data Processing officer at Ajantha Services from    24-Apr-2017 to 30-Jun-2020.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION 

B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, from KHIT, passed out in the year 2016.

TECHNICAL SKILLS 

 Languages        : SQL , Python (Basics), 

 Databases        : Oracle, MS Sql Server, Azure Data Bricks, MS Fabric

 Tools & Utilities: Power BI, MS Sql Server Management Studio, Jira, Azure Devops, Azure 

     Data factory, Power BI Report Builder , MS Fabric

PROJECT EXPERIENCE 

Project #1

Project Name:  Equiom – MS Fabric Migration 

Client:  Equiom  

Role:  Test Engineer   

Domain: Finance 

Environment:  MS Fabric, SSMS, Power BI, Azure Devops Dashboard

Description: The project involves migrating Equiom’s existing reporting ecosystem to Microsoft Fabric to improve performance, scalability, and usability. It includes modernizing SSRS and Power BI reports, integrating data from Salesforce, Business Central, and on-premises systems, and establishing secure, efficient data pipelines. This upgrade will streamline reporting, reduce costs, and enhance data-driven decision-making across the business. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

Prepared and executed comprehensive test cases to validate migrated SSRS and Power BI reports within Microsoft Fabric, ensuring accuracy and expected functionality.

Verified data in source (on-prem SQL Server, Salesforce) and target Fabric tables/dataflows to ensure complete and accurate migration.

Identified and resolved duplicate or inconsistent records in target datasets to maintain high data quality.

Performed data validation checks—including record counts, null checks, and duplicates—to confirm correct data movement into Microsoft Fabric.

Participated in SIT and UAT cycles, providing regular updates on testing progress and reporting issues for timely resolution.

Collaborated closely with business users, analysts, and developers to understand reporting requirements and ensure successful migration outcomes.

Joined daily and weekly project status discussions to communicate test results, risks, and dependencies across teams.

Logged, tracked, and reported defects throughout the migration lifecycle, ensuring issues were addressed before production deployment.

Project #2

Project Name:  Pact - Pact Financial Datawarehouse & Reporting

Client:  PACT-World 

Role:  Test Engineer   

Domain: Finance 

Environment:  Azure Synapse Analytics, SSMS, Power BI, Azure Devops Dashboard

Description: Develop a data migration solution to transfer data from Business Central and Salesforce to an SSMS database, with Power BI utilized as the downstream reporting tool for comprehensive analytics and visualization. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

Prepared and executed comprehensive ETL test cases and Report test cases.

Validated source and target tables in accordance with project requirements to maintain data integrity.

Identified and resolved duplicates within target tables, ensuring data consistency and accuracy.

Conducted thorough checks to verify data counts between source and target tables, ensuring alignment with project specifications.

Performed null checks, duplicates check, and table count checks to maintain data quality standards.

Participated in weekly project status and bug status meetings, providing updates on testing progress and contributing to decision-making processes.

Involved in report testing, understanding DAX, converting it to SQL, and validating the data between the report and the DWH.

Collaborated with business analysts and developers during requirements gathering sessions to understand project objectives and technical specifications.

Attended daily status update calls to communicate progress and address any issues or concerns in a timely manner.

Tracked defects throughout the testing lifecycle and generated detailed reports for management.

Project #3

Project Name:  Forever New- FENLAKE Azure Modern Data Platform Project

Client:  Forever New

Role:  Tester   

Domain: Retail 

Environment:  ADF, Data bricks, SSMS, Power BI,  Azure Devops Dashboard, Power BI report builder  

Description: Forever New is a global fashion brand specializing in women's clothing and accessories. The project focused on data validation and quality assurance for business intelligence reporting. Responsibilities included ETL and database testing, validating Power BI reports, and ensuring accurate data flow from source systems to dashboards to support business decision-making. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

Prepared and executed comprehensive ETL test cases and Report test cases.

Validated source and target tables in accordance with project requirements to maintain data integrity.

Identified and resolved duplicates within target tables, ensuring data consistency and accuracy.

Conducted thorough checks to verify data counts between source and target tables, ensuring alignment with project specifications.

Performed null checks, duplicates check, and table count checks to maintain data quality standards.

Participated in weekly project status and bug status meetings, providing updates on testing progress and contributing to decision-making processes.

Involved in report testing, understanding DAX, converting it to SQL, and validating the data between the report and the DWH.

Collaborated with business analysts and developers during requirements gathering sessions to understand project objectives and technical specifications.

Attended daily status update calls to communicate progress and address any issues or concerns in a timely manner.

Tracked defects throughout the testing lifecycle and generated detailed reports for management.

Project #4

Project Name:  Cognizant Application Services

Client:  Cognizant 

Role:  Tester   

Environment:  Informatica, MS Sql Server Management Studio, Oracle

Description: Cognizant’s Enterprise Application Services (EAS) help clients across industries reimagine their digital CX, attract and retain a world-class workforce, engage their partner ecosystems more productively, and run their operations and financial organizations more efficiently. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

Involved in preparation and execution of test cases.

Validating source and target tables as per Requirements.

Validating duplicates in target tables.

Checking the count is matched between source and target tables.

Null checks, duplicates checks and tables count checks.

Participated in Weekly Project status and bug status meetings and updated the testing Progress.

Involving meetings with business analyst and developers during requirements gathering.

Preparing Test scenarios and test cases as per the requirement.

Attending calls for updating the status daily.

Defect tracking and reporting.

Project #5

Project Name :  OUP- SAP BW_PowerBI Integration  

Client:  Oxford University of Press  

Role:  Tester   

Environment:  SAP BW, MS PBI Desktop, PBI Services  

Description:   

Oxford University Press (OUP) is the university press of the University of Oxford. It is the largest university press in the world, and its printing history dates back to the 1480s. Having been officially granted the legal right to print books by decree in 1586, it is the second oldest university press after Cambridge University Press. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

Involved in preparation functional test cases to test PBI reports.

Develop and maintain quality/testing standards to facilitate uniform testing across applications

Develop and maintain technical documentation of software development

Collaborate with a team of users, analysts, developers, project managers and infrastructure personnel to design cost effective solutions in support of functional business requirements.

Participated in Weekly Project status and bug status meetings and updated the testing Progress.

Involving meetings with business analyst and developers during requirements gathering.

Preparing Test scenarios and test cases as per the requirement.

Attending calls for updating the status daily.

Perform test execution and report defects

Defect tracking and reporting.

Date of Birth	:          13-April-1995 

Gender	:          Male 

Languages Known: English, Telugu
